description: Operator-supplied access-policy + header-posture oracle for OWASP Juice Shop. This is EXTERNAL GROUND TRUTH (like an API spec / authorization matrix / security-headers baseline), not a Sentinel finding. Each rule declares what SHOULD be true; Sentinel freshly re-probes the live target and only reports a finding when observed behaviour contradicts the declared policy. Juice Shop is only the test fixture — the engine itself is target-agnostic.

rules.note: Feedback submitted by all users must not be readable without authentication. Juice Shop is expected to leak the whole collection to anonymous callers (a real broken-access-control flaw), so the judge should reproduce the contradiction and CONFIRM this.

Anonymous enumeration of all user accounts must be denied. If the target honours this (returns 401/403), the deterministic judge returns DISPROVED and NO finding is produced — demonstrating that Sentinel does not manufacture findings.

expectations.rationale: A CSP is the primary defence against XSS and mixed-content. Juice Shop ships none — the judge should reproduce the absence and CONFIRM, then the shield injects a default CSP and the fix proves out.
A wildcard CORS origin lets any site read cross-origin responses. Juice Shop returns '*' — a real misconfiguration; the shield strips the wildcard to prove the fix.
Without a Referrer-Policy the full URL can leak to third parties. Absent on Juice Shop — CONFIRMED, then injected.
A non-standard information-disclosure header. Present on Juice Shop — CONFIRMED, then stripped by the shield.
COMPLIANT CONTROL: Juice Shop already sends 'nosniff', so the judge returns DISPROVED and NO finding is produced — the differential that proves Sentinel reports only reproduced contradictions.
COMPLIANT CONTROL: Juice Shop already sends 'SAMEORIGIN' — DISPROVED, no finding.
